label: All max
rationale: Every stat at the generation's IV ceiling — the usual starting point when you want full inheritance flexibility.

label: Physical attacker
rationale: Max physical bulk and Attack; Special Attack left untargeted because this role does not rely on it.

label: Special attacker
rationale: Zero Attack limits Foul Play and confusion self-damage while keeping special offenses and bulk maxed.

rationaleByGeneration.3: Zero Attack limits confusion self-damage while keeping special offenses and bulk maxed.
rationaleByGeneration.4: Zero Attack limits confusion self-damage while keeping special offenses and bulk maxed.

label: All 0
rationale: Minimum IVs in every stat — used when a move or strategy wants the lowest possible Speed or offenses (for example Gyro Ball).
